text: I see the problem. i think its your grid still actually. look here. i am looking to place a wall. see how its on the grid line and its spans 3 [Image #8] ok so lets zoom out on that exact same spot [Image #9] not on any grid line at all at this point which i think is the problem. worth fixing at least
resolution: User pinned it: a wall on the 1-tile grid read as ON the line zoomed in but OFF it zoomed out (same spot). The LOD grid coarsened far too early — at default zoom (~90m eye) the formula chose a 4-tile cell, so 1-tile-snapped pieces sat between the visible coarse lines and only landed on lines once zoomed in enough for the grid to drop to 1-tile cells. Retuned: size the grid coverage to the VISIBLE ground (~0.31x eye distance instead of 0.65x) and raise the line budget (HALF_LINES 28->56), so the grid holds the true 1 tile = 1 m pitch down to ~zoom 0.5 (the whole practical building range) and only coarsens to 2/4/8 cells when surveying a district where single cells aren't placeable. Bounded ~226 boxes, memoized. Committed 739223361.
